title: Reward Errors Change Memory Before They Change Policy

new_evidence.support_qualification: 8 offline deterministic retrieval-hit futures, 2 intent templates, 4 selected source identities; qualified with zero provider calls before writer execution
new_evidence.write_replication: 4/4 required Reddit source pairs change content and title sets; mean token Jaccard distance 0.652342
new_evidence.native_terminal: 8 frozen futures, 64 scientific terminal calls, mean |delta|=0.125, permutation p=0.225268, unchanged practical floor=0.15, gate fail
new_evidence.heterogeneity: 6/8 zero; two nonzero cells are 0.5 in different intent templates with opposite signs; every leave-one-task-out mean remains below 0.15
new_evidence.execution_repair: 4096-token writer parent had one length/no-text failure; R1 uniformly regenerated all eight writer units fresh at 8192 with no reuse of parent successes

story_adjudication.reason: Reddit strengthens the same stage-resolved story rather than creating a new one: write-time divergence transfers across domains, whereas native branch magnitude remains conditional and heterogeneous. The Shopping first-action experiment remains the mechanism-localization evidence; Reddit is a generalization/boundary experiment, not evidence that the uptake bottleneck is identical in every domain.
forbidden_reframes: native branch transport is universally near zero
Shopping magnitude 0.02083 is a cross-domain law
Reddit p=0.225 is evidence of no effect
Reddit 0.125 is a positive practical transport result
story_adjudication.revised_bounded_claim: Reward-conditioned writing transfers more robustly than native behavioral magnitude. Across Shopping and Reddit, label-conditioned memories reliably diverge at write time, while native branch transport is domain/task heterogeneous and neither evaluated domain establishes the prespecified broad practical effect.

next_experiment_policy.reason: The second-domain question is already answered at useful resolution; expanding Reddit task count would require non-deterministic/live evaluators and would change the evidence substrate.
reopen_only_if: a third domain has outcome-independent offline deterministic support comparable to the frozen Reddit qualification
a live source-faithful endpoint becomes available under the already specified transport contract
or a second downstream policy can execute the full frozen support without provider-support failure
